objective: Implement deterministic point-in-time Market Structure and Price Action family evidence without future leakage, duplicate correlated votes, or trade authority.
scope: Define governed P08-D policy for market structure and price action
Validate a single-symbol single-timeframe trusted OHLCV structure window with consistent dataset and quality lineage
Detect confirmed swing highs and swing lows using left/right confirmation bars
Compute break-of-structure context as a correlated market-structure transform
Classify latest-candle price action from body-to-range and close-location thresholds
Emit exactly one MARKET_STRUCTURE evidence object and one PRICE_ACTION evidence object per evaluation
Use one independence group per family while keeping cross-family independence PROVISIONAL_PENDING_P08_H
Reconcile P08-D task and lock state across GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Signal fusion, probability calibration, risk approval or execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: active task none and active lock none before P08-D activation
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P08 source
Confirmed higher-high/higher-low structure produces bullish MARKET_STRUCTURE evidence
Confirmed lower-high/lower-low structure produces bearish MARKET_STRUCTURE evidence
Insufficient confirmed structure produces neutral MARKET_STRUCTURE evidence without inventing swings
Strong bullish candle produces bullish PRICE_ACTION evidence
Strong bearish candle produces bearish PRICE_ACTION evidence
Doji or weak candle produces neutral PRICE_ACTION evidence
Swing detection never uses unconfirmed right-edge extrema
Correlated structure transforms share one independence group
Correlated candle transforms share one independence group
Cross-family independence remains explicitly provisional pending P08-H
P08-D evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No execution adapter or broker/exchange/order authority is imported
No network or credential access is required
rollback: Revert P08-D policy, module, tests, evidence/CI wiring and P08-D active-state reconciliation. P08-A/B/C remain canonical and no trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Market Structure and Price Action families implemented with governed evidence outputs
Confirmed swings are point-in-time and do not use future bars
Correlated transforms within each family do not create duplicate independent votes
Cross-family independence is not promoted beyond PROVISIONAL_PENDING_P08_H
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
